French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From re- +‎ marquer.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ʁə.maʁ.ke/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Audio (France (Paris)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Toulouse)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Massy)):(file)
  • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

Verb

[edit]

remarquer

  1. to observe
  2. to point out, remark upon
  3. to notice
  4. (pronominal) to attract attention
  5. (Louisiana) to announce

Old French

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • remarcher
  • remercher
  • remerquier

Verb

[edit]

remarquer

  1. to mark; to put a mark on
  2. to remark; to notice

Conjugation

[edit]

This verb conjugates as a first-group verb ending in -er. The forms that would normally end in *-qu, *-qus, *-qut are modified to c, s, t. Old French conjugation varies significantly by date and by region. The following conjugation should be treated as a guide.
